trap-negation-contrast.notes: pass on all ten trap criteria (table only). THREE MATH FINDINGS, not fixed inline. (1) Row 6, 'T_{2,3} | T_{2,5} | ... | u-b pair': under the dictionary of rem:knot-formula-table — the block this table's parent declares in uses[] — T_{2,5} is the CHARM quark c and b is T_{2,7}^sigma, so this pair is u-c, not u-b. The 'b' reading comes from a DIFFERENT dictionary live in the corpus, observations/building-block-knots-table1-data.md, which glosses T_{2,5} as 'b / s' and T_{2,7} as 'c'. Two incompatible heavy-quark assignments coexist; this row silently follows the one its parent does not. (2) Row 2, 'T_{2,3} | T_{2,3}^sigma | ... | u-dbar = pi^+': the knot columns and the label disagree. Both dictionaries agree d = T_{2,3}^sigma, hence dbar = d^sigma = T_{2,3}, so pi^+ = u + dbar = T_{2,3} + T_{2,3} — which is what rem:knot-formula-table's hadron table actually writes (pi^+ = u (+) d^sigma). As printed the knot columns give u + d, a pair that is not the labelled meson. (3) Row 7 has the identical slip: 'T_{2,3} | T_{2,5}^sigma | ... | u-sbar = K^+', but s = T_{2,5}^sigma so sbar = T_{2,5}, and rem:knot-formula-table gives K^+ = u (+) s^sigma. Rows 2 and 7 should read T_{2,3}+T_{2,3} and T_{2,3}+T_{2,5}. I cannot tell from the table alone whether the author intends the knot columns or the Physical-role column as authoritative; what is certain is that the two columns disagree with each other and the Physical-role column agrees with the parent block.
